name: Olutasidenib

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm and cancer risk

fda.text: DIFFERENTIATION SYNDROME Differentiation syndrome, which can be fatal, can occur with REZLIDHIA treatment. Symptoms may include dyspnea, pulmonary infiltrates/pleuropericardial effusion, kidney injury, hypotension, fever, and weight gain. 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatotoxicity : Monitor liver function tests during treatment with REZLIDHIA. If hepatotoxicity occurs, interrupt and reduce or discontinue REZLIDHIA. summary: Olutasidenib has a boxed warning, the strongest type from the FDA, for differentiation syndrome, a potentially fatal condition that can cause shortness of breath, lung or heart fluid, kidney damage, low blood pressure, fever, and weight gain [3]. The drug also carries a warning for liver toxicity, which requires monitoring liver function tests [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M].
